description: MTA Subway Schedules is a series of datasets listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset includes data for subway schedules, both the base schedule and the supplement schedule in effect. It includes rows for each scheduled stop on a trip. Coverage: New York State. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are subway lines, lines, subway schedules, subway, staten island railway. The table has 23 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-02-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
